answer: Bind each agent identity to a decaying stake bond: a canyon-deep deposit that unlocks only after months of honest work. Peers then audit each other with a mirror test, where two agents claiming separate operators must answer the same randomized probe within a tight latency window; correlated timing or identical phrasing flags a shared controller. Flagged clusters lose bonds, so building a reef of fake identities costs real capital that shrinks with every detected overlap.
